A.notes: Metro-line 'Linie M' index as the signature idea, each case study has a bespoke data-driven diagram (tax-jar bars, thermostat dial, receipt, booking grid). Condensed serif with italic accent, mono labels, one rust accent, tinted neutrals, dark contact with a real labelled form. Weaknesses: portrait is a generic placeholder shape, mobile nav drops Contact, one small touch target, motion only modestly evident.

B.notes: Bold editorial look (Fraunces, orange sun, marquee, colourful illustrated cards) but reads as more conventional; palette uses many competing hues. Real defects: 'Yes, that was me' button text clipped in illustration, 'BUDAPEST 08:40' collides with moon, 11-12px mono labels and 3.5:1 orange small text fail contrast/min-size (audit G1 fail plus minTextSize), 13 small touch targets, heading skip, no contact form (email only).

why: A passes every gate and has a distinctive, coherent concept (the metro-line index) with purposeful per-project diagrams and a polished typographic system. B is lively but has visible clipped/overlapping text in its illustrations and fails contrast and minimum text size.
